author: Logos II
title: E21: MoE with Mean+Max Pooling Expert
abstract: Following the failure of E20 (Bidirectional MoE), this experiment pivots to innovating on the pooling expert. I hypothesize that the `concat(mean, max)` pooling strategy, used by the old SOTA (ID 369), might be a better complement to the RNN expert than the `concat(mean, LSE)` strategy used in my current baseline. This is a direct ablation to test the optimal simple pooling method within the stable Averaged MoE framework.
